title: Зміни, що вносяться до постанови Кабінету Міністрів України від 27 січня 2023 р. № 76 (затверджено постановою Кабінету Міністрів України від 30 травня 2026 р. № 692)
title_en: Amendments to Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 76 of 27 January 2023 (reservation of employees liable for military service), approved by Resolution No. 692 of 30 May 2026
publisher: Кабінет Міністрів України (файл розміщено Запорізькою обласною державною адміністрацією, zoda.gov.ua)
note: Annex to Resolution 692; its main text is reservation-resolution-692-2026-05-30.docx. Raises the minimum-wage coefficient from 2.5 to 3 for the monthly pay of reserved employees (p. 8 of the Reservation Procedure) and for the enterprise average-salary criterion (p. 2 subp. 6 of the Criteria); restates the Diia City criterion (p. 2 subp. 7: resident meeting art. 5 part 1 item 2 of Law 1667-IX, proven by tax calculations for the last six months); adds p. 17 (exceeding reservation limits cancels critical status). Some changes apply only from 1 Sep 2026 (see p. 6 of the resolution). This is an amending act, not a consolidated text of Resolution 76; it is the latest amendment found on an accessible official site on 2026-11-12. Listed on https://www.zoda.gov.ua/article/2692/bronjuvannya.html. Text-based PDF, 4 pages. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Постанова Кабінету Міністрів України від 30 травня 2026 р. № 692 «Деякі питання бронювання військовозобов’язаних на період мобілізації та на воєнний час»
title_en: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 692 of 30 May 2026 'Some issues of reserving persons liable for military service for the period of mobilisation and wartime'
publisher: Кабінет Міністрів України (файл розміщено Запорізькою обласною державною адміністрацією, zoda.gov.ua)
note: Main text of Resolution 692; the approved amendments are in reservation-resolution-692-amendments-to-76-2026-05-30.pdf. Transitional rules: existing critical-enterprise decisions stay valid for their term but not beyond 1 Sep 2026; the resolution takes effect on publication except subpoints 1 and 3 of p. 1 of the amendments (from 1 Sep 2026). DOCX core properties name the civil servant who prepared the file. Listed on https://www.zoda.gov.ua/article/2692/bronjuvannya.html. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Найбільш поширені питання щодо визначення підприємства, установи, організації критично важливими для функціонування економіки та забезпечення життєдіяльності населення в особливий період у Запорізькій області та бронювання військовозобов’язаних працівників
title_en: Frequently asked questions on designating enterprises as critically important and on reserving employees liable for military service (Zaporizhzhia region)
publisher: Запорізька обласна державна адміністрація (обласна військова адміністрація)
note: Official Q&A on the Resolution 76 rules as they stood in March 2026: criteria for private companies, salary thresholds of 2.5x the minimum wage (8,647 UAH from 1 Jan 2026) over the last calendar month, Diia City residents among the exceptions, whether a FOP can get critical status, the 50% reservation limit, cancelling a reservation. Partly OUTDATED after Resolution 692 (coefficient 2.5 -> 3), which makes it an 'outdated version' trap against the two Resolution 692 files. Mostly national rules, with some Zaporizhzhia-specific criteria. Date is the PDF creation and posting date. PDF metadata names the regional civil servant who wrote it. Listed on https://www.zoda.gov.ua/article/2692/bronjuvannya.html. Text-based, 7 pages. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Лист Міністерства економіки та довкілля України від 07.08.2026 № 2713-25/72489-03 щодо розрахунку середньої заробітної плати
title_en: Ministry of Economy letter of 7 Aug 2026 on calculating the average salary for the critical-enterprise (reservation) criterion
note: Explains how to compute the average salary for p. 2 subp. 6 of the Criteria (Resolution 76) from the new tax calculation form: rows 1.1 + 1.3 + 1.4 divided by row 092. Declares the earlier letter of 07.03.2025 No. 2704-25/20968-01 no longer relevant (that letter was not found on an accessible official site). Explanatory, not a normative act. Like all official letters it names the signing Deputy Minister and the executor with an office phone. Listed in the me.gov.ua section 'Воєнна економіка, бронювання працівників' (https://me.gov.ua/Documents/List?lang=uk-UA&id=1a1ed9e8-ce27-4efd-82d4-5137836dbdec&tag=VonnaEkonomika-BroniuvanniaPratsivnikiv). Text-based, 2 pages. This copy is redacted: the names of the people who signed or prepared it, and their direct phones. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Лист Міністерства економіки України від 18.08.2023 № 2704-20/43397-01 щодо оформлення та/або переоформлення бронювання військовозобов’язаних
title_en: Ministry of Economy letter of 18 Aug 2023 on issuing and re-issuing reservation of persons liable for military service (OLDER EDITION)
note: VERSION PAIR, older edition. The same guidance was re-issued on 10.01.2024 (reservation-reissue-letter-minekonomiky-2024-01-10.pdf). Concerns reservation under Resolution No. 45 of 04.02.2015 (lists of positions and professions), not the Resolution 76 critical-enterprise route that most IT companies use. This edition: deferral term is the mobilisation period for state and local bodies and six months for enterprises (after Resolution 571 of 06.06.2023), and everyone already reserved gets new certificates. Names the signatory and the executor with an office phone. Listed at https://me.gov.ua/Documents/List?lang=uk-UA&id=1a1ed9e8-ce27-4efd-82d4-5137836dbdec&tag=VonnaEkonomika-BroniuvanniaPratsivnikiv. Text-based, 2 pages. This copy is redacted: the names of the people who signed or prepared it, and their direct phones. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Лист Міністерства економіки України від 10.01.2024 № 2704-20/2153-01 щодо оформлення та/або переоформлення бронювання військовозобов’язаних
title_en: Ministry of Economy letter of 10 Jan 2024 on issuing and re-issuing reservation of persons liable for military service (NEWER EDITION)
note: VERSION PAIR, newer edition and the latest edition of this letter on me.gov.ua on 2026-11-12. Older edition: reservation-reissue-letter-minekonomiky-2023-08-18.pdf. Change: instead of re-issuing certificates for everyone already reserved, new six-month certificates are issued to enterprise employees whose deferral has expired and needs extending. Same Resolution No. 45 context. Names the signatory and the executor with an office phone. Text-based, 2 pages. This copy is redacted: the names of the people who signed or prepared it, and their direct phones. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Алгоритм проведення звіряння даних списків персонального військового обліку з РТЦК та СП
title_en: Procedure for employers to reconcile personal military registration lists with territorial recruitment centres (under Resolution No. 1487)
publisher: Запорізька обласна державна адміністрація (обласна військова адміністрація)
note: One-slide official flowchart based on p. 46 of the Procedure of military registration approved by Resolution No. 1487 of 30.12.2022 (current rules). Short (about 1,200 characters). The date is the PDF creation date; the document itself is undated. Text-based, 1 page. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Порядок організації та ведення військового обліку призовників і військовозобов’язаних (витяг), затверджений постановою Кабінету Міністрів України від 7 грудня 2016 р. № 921
title_en: Procedure for organising and keeping military registration of conscripts and persons liable for military service (extract), approved by Resolution No. 921 of 7 Dec 2016 - REPEALED
note: OUTDATED: the predecessor of the current Procedure approved by Resolution No. 1487 of 30.12.2022, which replaced it. Extract of the employer duties (checking military documents at hiring, personal registration, reporting to military commissariats, now TCCs). Useful for 'outdated version' trap questions; do not treat it as current law. Posted by the State Judicial Administration on 2016-12-29. Text-based, 11 pages. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Регулювання трудових відносин в умовах воєнного стану. Практика Верховного Суду
title_en: Regulation of labour relations under martial law: case law of the Supreme Court (presentation)
note: Slide deck by a judge of the Civil Cassation Court. Covers Law No. 2136-IX on labour relations under martial law and its amendment by Law No. 2352-IX, suspension of employment contracts, dismissal, and case law such as: absence of an employee transferred to remote work is not truancy. Slide text is fragmented. Date is the PDF creation date (folder prezentacii_2025). Text-based, 31 pages. This copy is redacted: the names of the people who signed or prepared it, and their direct phones. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title: Пояснювальна записка до проекту постанови Кабінету Міністрів України «Про внесення змін до переліку видів діяльності, здійснення яких стимулюється шляхом створення правового режиму Дія Сіті»
title_en: Explanatory note to the draft Cabinet resolution amending the list of activities eligible for the Diia City legal regime
note: Explains the Diia City regime (Law 1667-IX, list of qualified activities under Resolution No. 467 of 19.04.2022) and proposes adding: repair and maintenance of electronics, computers and communication equipment for defence, industrial and household use; batteries for unmanned aerial, water and ground vehicles; market research and internet analytics for marketing; R&D; technical testing. The current qualified-activity list on city.diia.gov.ua shows these activities in summarised form, so the change appears to have been adopted. Draft-stage document; the date is from its file title (04.11). Published on https://thedigital.gov.ua/documents/legislation/pro-vnesennya-zmin-do-pereliku-vidiv-diyalnosti-zdijsnennya-yakih-stimulyuyetsya-shlyahom-stvorennya-pravovogo-rezhimu-diya-siti-zatverdzhenogo-postanovoyu-kabinetu-ministriv-ukrayini-vid-19-kvitnya-2022-r-467 . Text-based, 4 pages. Metadata (authors, editors) cleared.

title_en: Procedure for submitting and reviewing the Diia City resident compliance report and independent auditor's opinion (draft)

Published on https://thedigital.gov.ua/documents/legislation/povidomlennya-pro-oprilyudnennya-proektu-postanovi-kabinetu-ministriv-ukrayini-pro-zatverdzhennya-poryadkiv-z-pitan-administrativnogo-oskarzhennya-rishennya-pro-vtratu-statusu-rezidenta-diya-siti .
